candidates.title: All Praise to Him [Official Lyric Video]

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: All praise to Him, the God of light, who formed the
Mountains by His might
All praise to Him who names the stars That
Sing His fame in the skies afar
All praise to Him who reigns in love
Who guides the galaxies above
Yet bends to hear our every prayer
With sovereign power and tender care

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: All praise to Him whose love is seen
In Christ the Son,
The servant King
Who left behind His glorious throne
To pay the ransom for his own
All praise to Him who humbly came to
Bear our sorrows, sin and shame
Who lived to die,

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Who died to rise, the all-sufficient all-sufficient sacrifice
Rise, the unsufficient sacrifice

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, praise to Him whose power imparts the love of God
Within our hearts
The Spirit of all truth and peace,
The fount of joy and holiness
To Father, Son, and Spirit now,
Our souls we lift,
Our wills we bow
To you the triune God we raise

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: With loving hearts our song of praise
To Father, Son, and Spirit now
Our souls we lift,
Our wills we bow To
You the triune God we raise
With loving hearts our song of praise Thank you
